summary: Maine state 48-foot tower on Hunt Mountain, built 1924, moved to Lawler Hill in 1931 and removed in 1978; no source describes either site today.

notes_for_editor: Hunt Mountain is the 1924 original site; the structure was moved to Lawler Hill in 1931 and removed there in 1978, so the Lawler Hill record should carry the same chain (its own brief says Tower Gone). No source read describes the Hunt Mountain site or the Lawler Hill site today, and none states public access, so access is omitted rather than guessed. The 1924 facts come from newspaper items quoted on the Eastern US Lookouts page (Daily Kennebec Journal), not the originals. The brief's height 14.6 m matches the 48-foot figure. The FFLOS page spells the Lawler Hill location Benedicta, while the 1931 map says Benedicts; the story avoids the spelling. Research read budget exceeded by a few page reads on this record while sorting out the Lawler Hill move.
